- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER generated the highest revenue TW at £7.5k, followed by HAND WARMER RED POLKA DOT at £3.7k.
- HAND WARMER RED POLKA DOT led unit sales TW with 2004 units, while SET OF 20 VINTAGE CHRISTMAS NAPKINS achieved 1831 units.
- Total revenue TW reached £43.5k, representing a 147.1% increase WoW from £17.6k in LW.
- AFGHAN SLIPPER SOCK PAIR showed exceptional growth WoW with revenue increasing 52204.3%, though absolute TW revenue was not provided in the data.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER received the most orders TW at 67, compared to PAPER CHAIN KIT VINTAGE CHRISTMAS with 59 orders.
- SET OF 20 VINTAGE CHRISTMAS NAPKINS revenue grew £2.8k WoW, while BABUSHKA LIGHTS STRING OF 10 added £1.6k WoW.
- Total units sold TW across all products reached 17910 units, with top performers concentrated in seasonal and decorative categories.
- No year-over-year comparison available as LY revenue was £0.0k for the same ISO week period.
